Sam S: Heads-up — incoming security questionnaire from Sunrise Health (attached SIG + CAIQ + vendor risk matrix). AE asks for completed responses and a short POC/pricing note. Deadline requested: Tue EOD next week. They specifically call out: private VPC deployment, BYOK/KMS, key rotation, and SOC2 mapping. Doc: https://files.sunrisehealth.com/rdx-sig.pdf

Priya R: Assigning to security intake. @Liam V can you scope POC infra implications? Also need data classification and the customer's legal contact for redaction requests. Creating intake ticket now.

intake-bot: New intake ticket INT-4521 created by Sam S. Priority: high. Deadline (customer requested): 2024-08-13. Link: https://internal.redwood/inbox/INT-4521

Liam V: Got it. Quick infra notes: POC can run on hosted + dedicated pool (fastest) or Private VPC for isolation. For on-prem we'd need network allowlist + appliance. Question for the team — do we support BYOK with Dedicated, or only Private? Also need expected token QPS from AE to size the pool.

Priya R: We support BYOK for Private (customer KMS/HSM). Dedicated supports KMS proxy integration for key wrapping — will document. For the questionnaire Q3.2 (key rotation) suggested language: "Customer-managed keys rotated per customer policy; Redwood supports KMS integration (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure KeyVault) and can rotate keys on schedule. Access and rotation events are logged to audit streams and available to customer via the console."

Liam V: Thanks — pasting quick POC checklist I'll add to the ticket:

```
POC infra checklist:
- Deployment mode: Hosted / Dedicated pool / Private VPC
- If Private: CIDR ranges + peering details, egress rules
- KMS type: BYOK (HSM) or proxy integration
- Expected QPS and peak concurrency
- Data classification (PHI/PII/PD/none)
- Retention and telemetry export requirements
```

Priya R: I'll take ownership of the SIG/CAIQ answers. @Eve L any legal flags on sharing the vendor risk matrix? Customer asked us to fill entire matrix and return; they also asked to redact some columns on their side before sharing.

Eve L: NDA is in place but doesn't automatically cover redaction requests. We should ask customer legal to confirm redactions. Also flag: contract needs an explicit clause for export/processing of anonymized telemetry if they want us to share any logs. I'll reach out to their counsel.

Sam S: I'll ping the AE for the legal contact and ask for QPS estimate now. Will post updates in INT-4521. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Priya R: Setting internal target — complete and upload SIG responses to INT-4521 by 2024-08-12 COB. Owner: Priya R. :white_check_mark:

Liam V: On it — adding the infra checklist and rough pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted into the ticket by EOD tomorrow.

intake-bot: Ticket INT-4521 updated: owner=Priya R; status=In Progress; due=2024-08-12; tags=[security, sales, poc]
